newsitem.title: UK: London shares close lower, await U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: London shares close lower, await U.S. jobs data.

text.p: UK shares ended lower on Thursday as recent volatility on Wall Street prompted a small pull-back from Wednesday's all-time highs.

Continued fears that the Dow could be on the verge of a substantial downward correction weighed on investor sentiment but steady UK and U.S. interest rates helped calm but not eradicate jittery market nerves.
"It wasn't a bad day considering Wall Street's slide yesterday," the head of trading at a large investment bank said.
"But the market is still on edge."
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares closed 15.6 points down at 4,265.9.
